title: MZ Resolution Issues with the Editor display

posts.author: Laharl
posts.body:
Hey, so i wasted a bunch of time making props and assets in an isometic view(32x32) and carefully laying them out in the editor but well... heres how it looks in the editor:
Spoiler:
EditorView
in game when loading it normally the same issue also happens to an extent, so i used a zoom plugin to fix it though apperently i later found out i can simply change a few settings in the System2 tab regarding resolution and Screen scale and it fixed the jagged pixel.
I remember using RPG maker XP, VX(and VX ace) as well as 2003 and never have i encountered such an issue, i tried messing with my own PC resolution and that didnt help either.
is there a way to fix this? not only is it impossible to view detail but it also forces me to either relay on stacking images or using a third program like Tiled just to make this work?
